title: Meir Schreibman family
summary: The memorial-book index identifies Meir Schreibman, his wife Dabeh, and their sons Gabriel and Reuben. The family’s dates, residence, and wartime fate require further documentation.
editorialContent:
## Members
- Meir Schreibman
- Dabeh Schreibman, wife of Meir
- Gabriel Schreibman, son of Meir
- Reuben Schreibman, son of Meir

The family relationship is based on the Sokółka memorial-book index. The nearby entry for Dorah Schreibman and two children is not included because the source does not establish that household’s connection to Meir.

sources.title: Memorial Book of Sokolka: List of Martyrs, pages 751–768
